title: Halting language in biased randomized polynomial time
statement: The language of Boolean strings whose logarithmic length parameter is at least $1$, whose output length equals the corresponding prefix of the halting bits, and whose preceding halting bit is $1$ belongs to the class of languages decidable in polynomial time by a finite-state randomized Turing machine with independent choice bits that are true with probability equal to the halting number, and with acceptance probability at least $2/3$ on every input.
